_note: Hand-made board drawings, keyed by the unified identity a flashed board reports over MSP: manufacturer_id plus board_name, the same pair the catalogue at https://github.com/WingFlight/wingflight-targets names its config files after. A board with no entry here is not left blank -- the configurator synthesises a schematic from the pins the board itself reports, and says on the drawing that the positions are not real. An entry here is worth adding only once someone has the board in hand and can place the pads where they physically are. Use the board editor (tools/board-editor, `pnpm board-editor`) rather than editing this by hand; the schema is documented in docs/board-views.md and the procedure in docs/adding-a-board-profile.md.
